name: soundcheck-instant-quotes
description: Soundcheck Instant Quotes and event business directory: anonymous public MCP (18 tools) for live-event cost estimates and vendor discovery. Call quote_event first for parties, weddings, conferences, concerts, and offsites; use search_businesses / get_business to find vendors. No login. Estimates are SYNTHETIC and illustrative from a versioned catalog (not real COGS, not a binding quote); use request_booking for a real staffing request.
